the first time i visited Anthropic it was a 160-person start-up in Jackson Square with no products and no revenue. there was an office throne made of empty Liquid Death cans and everyone seemed vaguely allergic to making money.

that was THREE YEARS AGO.

now they're going to go public at $400 quadrillion and bring about the teleological end of capitalism. what a world.

i haven't said much about the book because i've been so busy writing it, but it is by a large margin the hardest and most satisfying creative project i've ever done.

i got deep access to OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind and interviewed more than 150 lab insiders about the last decade in AI. it has scoops galore, and a bunch of never-before-told stories and internal documents about the race to AGI, and i hope it will be a true time capsule of this strange and exciting era.
